parameters.name: S
parameters.description: Seen as the next filament slot followed by A, or 255.

description: UNDOCUMENTED and UNVERIFIED: Bambu Lab private command. Starts a conditional block: OrcaSlicer's X1 templates (OrcaSlicer@09aa0114:resources/profiles/BBL/machine/Bambu Lab X1 0.4 nozzle template machine_start_gcode.json:5) write "M1002 judge_flag <flag>" then M622 J1 or J0, ended by M623; OrcaSlicer's time estimate treats M622 J1 after the bed-levelling flag as G29 time (src/libslic3r/GCode/GCodeProcessor.cpp:6927). Parameter meanings are guesses from those alone.

parameters.name: J
parameters.description: Seen as 1 (run when the flag is set) or 0 (when it is not).

description: UNDOCUMENTED and UNVERIFIED: Bambu Lab private command. OrcaSlicer writes it before each object's moves (and per layer, after "; object ids of layer N start"), with the object label ids encoded in base64 (OrcaSlicer@09aa0114:src/libslic3r/GCode.cpp:6505), so the printer can skip a cancelled object; M625 ends the block. Meaning inferred from that code alone.
UNDOCUMENTED and UNVERIFIED: Bambu Lab private command. Ends the block an M624 opens (OrcaSlicer@09aa0114:src/libslic3r/GCode.cpp:6508). Meaning inferred from that code alone.

UNDOCUMENTED and UNVERIFIED: Bambu Lab private command. OrcaSlicer's BBL machine start G-code (OrcaSlicer@09aa0114:resources/profiles/BBL/machine/fdm_machine_common.json:163) writes it in pairs after G28, followed by M974, apparently for the vibration (resonance) test. No comment explains it; parameter meanings are unknown.

UNDOCUMENTED and UNVERIFIED: Bambu Lab private command. OrcaSlicer's X1 timelapse template (OrcaSlicer@09aa0114:resources/profiles/BBL/machine/Bambu Lab X1 0.4 nozzle template time_lapse_gcode.json:5) writes M971 S11 C10 O0 to take a timelapse frame; the start template uses M971 S5 and S6 during calibration, apparently for camera captures. Parameter meanings are guesses.

UNDOCUMENTED and UNVERIFIED: Bambu Lab private command. OrcaSlicer's BBL machine start G-code (OrcaSlicer@09aa0114:resources/profiles/BBL/machine/fdm_machine_common.json:163) writes it after each pair of M970, apparently to finish the vibration test. No comment explains it; parameter meanings are unknown.

UNDOCUMENTED and UNVERIFIED: Bambu Lab private command. OrcaSlicer writes M981 S1 P20000 commented "open spaghetti detector" (OrcaSlicer@09aa0114:src/libslic3r/GCode.cpp:4607) and M981 S0 P20000 to close it, also telling the camera the last layer is done (GCode.cpp:4808). Parameter meanings are guesses.

UNDOCUMENTED and UNVERIFIED: Bambu Lab private command. OrcaSlicer writes M1003 S1 or S0 for Bambu printers to switch power-loss recovery on or off (OrcaSlicer@09aa0114:src/libslic3r/GCodeWriter.cpp:761); Bambu Studio comments it "open powerlost recovery".

UNDOCUMENTED and UNVERIFIED: Bambu Lab private command. OrcaSlicer's time estimate lists T255 as a special Bambu command that is not a tool change (OrcaSlicer@09aa0114:src/libslic3r/GCode/GCodeProcessor.cpp:7105); the X1 end template writes it after moving to the cutter, apparently to unload the filament.
